services.name: Exclusive Private Boat Charter
services.desc: Exclusive Private Boat Cruise Duration 2-Hours Additional Time May Be Available About Elevate your special occasions on the water with us! Whether it's a Birthday, Anniversary, Wedding, or any noteworthy event, our Private Boat Charters offer the perfect venue, available 7 days a week in season. Our custom-built party boat, designed for versatility, can host up to 48 passengers. Experience top-notch amenities, including a surround-sound speaker system, LED lighting for enchanting evening cruises, a restroom, and a full-service bar. Explore local catering options to elevate your group's experience! Pricing & Availability: $1,300 (plus taxes/fees) for up to 25 guests $1,500 for 26-45 guests

Duration: 1 Hour About: Experience the city's rich history from a unique vantage point while savoring a refreshing cocktail from our onboard Tiki Bar! Learn about the city's past as one of the biggest shipbuilding ports of its time, slightly narrated by our knowledgeable crew. The Brandywine, custom-built and Coast Guard inspected to carry 49 passengers, is fully equipped with a full bar and restroom for your convenience.
